auth.heroTitle: Good food for home kitchens and growing businesses.
auth.heroDescription: Bite to Business serves households, restaurants, cafés, offices and businesses. Find the right ingredients for your kitchen.

loginNote.title: Just sent your application?
loginNote.detail1: An admin will review your details
loginNote.detail2: Receive an activation OTP after approval
loginNote.detail3: Then come back here to sign in

registerNote.title: Shop with Bite to Business
registerNote.detail2: After an admin approves your application
registerNote.step3: Verify your OTP and set a password

login.activationComplete: Your account is activated. Sign in with the password you just created.
login.title: Welcome back
login.description: Sign in with Gmail to place orders, track deliveries and find products for your kitchen.
login.passwordHelp: To reset your password, please contact your administrator and provide your registered Gmail address.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Send your application to Bite to Business for approval before activating your account. Takes about 2 minutes.
register.emailHint: This is also your sign-in email. Your activation OTP will be sent here after approval.
register.deliveryHint: You can choose another address when placing an order.
register.addressHint: Enter only the house number, street and neighborhood. The city and ward are added automatically.
register.businessNameHint: The business, shop or household receiving the delivery.
register.invoiceHint: All invoice information is optional. Leave it blank if you do not need an invoice yet.
register.sameInvoiceAddress: Invoice address is the same as delivery address
register.submitNote: Please review your details before submitting. Your application will be sent to an admin for approval and cannot be edited afterwards.
register.successDescription: Once an admin approves your application, an OTP will be sent to the Gmail address below. Enter it to continue to password setup.

verifyOtp.title: Verify your account
verifyOtp.description: Enter your registered Gmail and the OTP received after admin approval.
verifyOtp.codeHint: Enter the 6–10 digit code from your email, including any leading zeros.
verifyOtp.resendHint: No code yet? Wait for admin approval and check your spam folder. Contact the admin for a new code if it has expired.
verifyOtp.waitingApproval: Your application has not been approved or an OTP has not been sent yet. Please wait for the email from Bite to Business.
verifyOtp.setupExpired: Your password setup session is no longer valid. Ask the admin for a new OTP and verify again.
verifyOtp.resumeText: Already submitted your application and received an OTP?

setPassword.title: Create your password
setPassword.description: Your email is verified. Create a sign-in password for
setPassword.passwordHint: Use 8–72 characters. You will return to sign in after creating your password.

placeholders.deliveryNote: e.g. Call before delivery, use the back gate…

address.serviceArea: Currently serving Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City using the new two-level administrative addresses.
address.loadError: Could not load the address list. Please try again.

errors.invalidOtp: The OTP is incorrect or has already been used. Please check it again.
errors.otpExpired: The OTP has expired. Ask the admin for a new code.
errors.setupExpired: Your password setup session has expired. Verify again with a new OTP.
errors.alreadyActivated: Your account is already activated. Please return to sign in.
errors.passwordLength: Your password must be 8–72 characters long.
errors.passwordMismatch: The password confirmation does not match.
errors.passwordPolicy: The password does not meet the password policy. Please choose another password.
errors.location: Please select a valid address from the list.
errors.gmail: Enter a valid Gmail address, e.g. yourname@gmail.com.
errors.name: Use letters, spaces, periods, apostrophes or hyphens only.
errors.phone: Enter a valid Vietnamese mobile number, e.g. 0912345678.
errors.taxCode: The tax code must contain exactly 10 digits.
errors.tooLong: This information is too long. Please shorten it.
errors.credentials: Your Gmail or password is incorrect. Please try again.
errors.banned: Your account is blocked. Please contact your administrator.
errors.notActivated: Your account is not activated. After admin approval, check Gmail to verify your OTP and create a password.
errors.emailExists: This Gmail address is already registered. Sign in or use another address.
errors.phoneExists: This phone number is already registered. Please use another number.
errors.network: Cannot connect to the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.timeout: The server took too long to respond. Please try again.
errors.notConfigured: The sign-in service is not configured. Please contact your administrator.
errors.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.validation: Some details are invalid. Please check the form fields.
errors.serverField: This information is invalid. Please check it again.
errors.unknown: Your request could not be completed. Please try again.
